name: fast-anything
description: Find the slow 5% of your app, port just that to Rust, and prove it still behaves the same.

interface.shortDescription: Port your app's hottest functions to Rust and prove they behave the same.
interface.longDescription: Profiles Python, Node, TypeScript, Ruby, Java, Kotlin, Go, PHP, C, C++, C# and R apps, records real calls to the hottest functions, has your agent port only those to Rust, replays every call to prove the port matches, and swaps it in reversibly.
defaultPrompt: Find the slowest functions in this app and port them to Rust
